verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions telemetry, analytics, or usage-tracking collection, nor any setting to opt out of it. The nearest items are adjacent privacy controls: the AI plugin is a separate, optional component meant to prevent accidental network transmission, the AI feature is off by default, and shell integration offers an Internet-Free Install. These cover AI data flow and installation, not a telemetry opt-out, so they earn no credit for this story.
